name: 44236 · Hudson, OH
findings: ZIP 44236 (Hudson) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44236 (Hudson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44236 (Hudson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
